hypotheses.name: Metric-matched geodesic persistence rescues rewiring-null failure
hypotheses.method: Ran immune full-layer source/target-disjoint screening with degree-preserving rewiring nulls, comparing both observed Euclidean H1 and observed geodesic H1 against rewired-geodesic null distributions via `conda run -n subproject40-topology python iterations/iter_0007/run_iter0007_screen.py`.
hypotheses.result_value: 0/24 significant; mean geodesic delta -95.356; min Fisher p 0.6913; dual-split pass 0/12
hypotheses.next_action: Replicate the same metric-matched rewiring protocol in external-lung to test whether this negative outcome generalizes across domains.

hypotheses.name: Metric mismatch is the dominant cause of rewiring-null negativity
hypotheses.method: Computed calibration-shift diagnostic per seed-layer-split as (geodesic delta - Euclidean delta) under the same rewired-geodesic null; additionally tested geodesic-distortion lower-tail significance.
hypotheses.result_value: Mean shift +0.180 (positive in 22/24 layer-split aggregates), but all geodesic tests remain non-significant (0/24) and distortion test is non-significant (0/24, min p 0.0696)
hypotheses.next_action: Introduce edge-length-bin-preserving rewiring to test whether stronger metric preservation materially increases the calibration shift and recovers any positive layers.
